== Biography ==
'''Katherine Glasgow''' was born in 1756 in West Calder, Midlothian, Scotland, daughter of [[Glasgow-81|John Glasgow]] and [[Guthrie-777|Magdalene Guthrie]].

Katherine married '''[[Nicol-149|Francis Nicol]]''' (born in 1752 in Scotland). Their children were:
* [[Nicol-151|Francis Nicol]] (1775– )
* [[Nicol-148|John Nicol]] (<1778–1854)
* [[Nicol-150|James Nicol]] (1778– )
